overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for UiA pages that carry the standard Læringsutbytte/Innhold/Undervisnings- og læringsformer/Vilkår/Eksamen headings: sub-headings stay in learning_outcomes, arbeidskrav go to coursework_requirements and prerequisites are clean. Most pre-pass flags are false alarms. Remaining issues are four plans whose harvested page has no course content at all, inconsistent handling of the 'Faget i praksis' sub-heading, and a Nynorsk table-of-contents heading mapped to course_content.

findings.description: Four of 14 suspects (PED428-1, IDR418-1, NAT115-1 2023, SV-158-1 2023) have a plan text consisting only of title, credits, faculty, the Timeplan/Pensumliste links and the programme list (NAT115/SV-158 also a Reduksjon i studiepoeng table). There is no Læringsutbytte, Innhold or Eksamen text, so no section rows are emitted. The extractor is not dropping content; the harvested page is a stub, but these rows are still counted as course plans (other years of the same course, e.g. NAT115-1 2022, have full content).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Harvest/fetch returned a UiA page version without the plan body (probably a not-yet-published or wrong-year plan), not a section reader problem.
findings.suggested_fix: Flag plans whose extracted text has no mapped content heading (only .drop/unmapped headings) as 'no_plan_content' in the fulltext/harvest step and exclude them from section statistics; re-harvest those course-years or fall back to a neighbouring year's URL.

findings.description: The sub-heading 'Faget i praksis' is routed inconsistently. In ERN403, TY-133, EN-153 and NO-157 it is a sub-heading mapped to teaching_methods (and in ERN403 its text is placed before the main teaching text). In NAT115-1 2022 the heading is not read at all and the practice paragraph stays in course_content (which also triggers the leak->teaching_methods flag). In MA-457 an inline 'Faget i praksis.' paragraph likewise stays in course_content. The same heading therefore yields different sections across courses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Faget i praksis' is detected as a sub-heading only when it follows a particular markup (separate heading element); in other pages it is a plain paragraph or bold text and is not recognised by the section_* reader config.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide one target for 'Faget i praksis' (teaching_methods per the current map is reasonable) and make the UiA reader recognise it also as a plain-paragraph/bold line (line-start pattern 'Faget i praksis' in R/section_heading_map.R), so it is consistent across pages; keep text order as on the page.

findings.description: On Nynorsk plans the table-of-contents heading 'Innhaldsliste' is mapped to course_content, whereas the Bokmål 'Innholdsfortegnelse' is mapped to .drop. Nothing leaked into the text in this example, but any content between the TOC heading and the next heading would be filed as course content. The Nynorsk label 'Innhald' is correctly course_content, so the pattern for 'Innhald' is probably matching the prefix of 'Innhaldsliste'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R: the course_content pattern for Innhald/Innhold matches 'Innhaldsliste' before the TOC (.drop) pattern, which only covers 'Innholdsfortegnelse' (first match wins).
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Innhaldsliste' to the .drop pattern and place it before the course_content pattern (or anchor the Innhald pattern with $).

findings.evidence: I tillegg må kravet om minimum 80% fremmøte til profesjonsfaglige samlinger være oppfylt.
findings.description: An attendance requirement (a pass/approve gate) sits under the Eksamen heading on the page and ends up in assessment; per the codebook such requirements belong in coursework_requirements. Same sentence in PRA044-1 2024 and PRA045-1 2024.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading-level splitting only; sentences under Eksamen are not classified individually.
findings.suggested_fix: Low priority: optionally move sentences matching 'må ... være oppfylt|fremmøte|tilstedeværelse' from assessment to coursework_requirements in .clean_sections().
